scope: Primary-source coverage audit against 100-company public roster; no financial metrics invented

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Qualcomm
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Edge AI processors, custom silicon and data-center inference accelerators
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Without Qualcomm the screen misses a major mobile/PC AI route and a competing inference architecture.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Roadmap products are not equivalent to realized data-center revenue.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Tencent
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: AI models, cloud services and AI monetization in advertising and games
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Major Chinese AI platform absent while Alibaba and Baidu are included.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Primary HKD counter 00700; RMB counter 80700 is the same issuer, not another company.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: SoftBank Group
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: AI capital allocator, OpenAI investor and semiconductor/infrastructure owner
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Central source of capital in the requested circulation map, not merely another software vendor.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Do not confuse with separately listed SoftBank Corp. 9434. Group and Arm financial exposure overlaps; avoid adding consolidated totals together.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Tokyo Electron
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Semiconductor deposition, etch, cleaning, coater/developer and advanced-packaging tools
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Broad wafer-fab equipment coverage is incomplete without this major Japanese supplier.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: TEL is an alias, but US ticker TEL belongs to TE Connectivity already in the roster. Tokyo Electron recorded a five-for-one split effective October 1, 2026: adjust any subsequent price history consistently.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Advantest
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Automated semiconductor and high-performance AI memory test equipment
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Complements Teradyne and captures test intensity in AI processors and high-bandwidth memory.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: ASM International
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Atomic layer deposition and epitaxy equipment
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Leading-edge logic and memory materials processing is a distinct upstream AI capex exposure.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Do not confuse with ASMPT, a separately listed company.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: ASE Technology Holding
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Outsourced semiconductor assembly/test and advanced packaging
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Packaging capacity is a critical AI supply-chain step absent as a standalone major issuer.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: ASX ADR and 3711 Taiwan shares represent the same group; count once.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Amkor Technology
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Adds another major packaging path and a documented Apple capacity-support relationship.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Company revenue is not all AI revenue.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: MediaTek
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Edge AI systems-on-chip and custom compute design
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: NVIDIA GB10 co-design supplies an explicit edge-to-data-center link outside the usual GPU names.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Lenovo Group
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: AI servers, storage, liquid cooling and AI PCs
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Major global server/PC supplier missing despite Dell, HPE and Supermicro coverage.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: LNVGY ADR and HKEX 992 are the same issuer.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Wiwynn
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Hyperscale compute/storage racks and direct liquid cooling
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Captures rack-scale integration and cooling beyond Foxconn and Quanta.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Wistron group relationship creates potential consolidated financial overlap if both are included.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Seagate Technology
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Mass-capacity hard drives and data-center storage
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Storage comparison is incomplete with Western Digital but no Seagate.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: AI is a demand driver, not the entirety of company revenue.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Sandisk
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: Western Digital no longer represents both HDD and flash after the 2025 separation.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Independent Nasdaq trading began February 24, 2025; do not count historical WDC flash revenue again.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Everpure
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Flash storage and data management for AI and hyperscalers
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: A named Meta design win makes this an observable second-tier participant.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: Corporate rename February 23, 2026; ticker changed to P in April 2026. PSTG is a historical search alias, not the October 2026 trading symbol.

recommendedPublicAdditions.name: Corning
recommendedPublicAdditions.role: Data-center optical fiber, cable and connectivity
recommendedPublicAdditions.whyEssential: A directly disclosed Meta agreement makes this a clear omission in physical AI infrastructure.
recommendedPublicAdditions.notes: The up-to-$6B multiyear agreement is a commitment ceiling, not cash already paid.

nextAddition.name: Wistron
nextAddition.role: AI server manufacturing and enterprise computing
nextAddition.whyEssential: Useful next addition after the first 15; broadens Taiwan ODM coverage.
nextAddition.notes: Keep Wistron and Wiwynn as distinct listed issuers while flagging group/consolidation overlap.

suggestedEdges.title: Completed Intel equity purchase
suggestedEdges.detail: Intel reports the sale of approximately 215 million shares to NVIDIA closed on December 26, 2025.
suggestedEdges.caveat: An equity financing inflow, not Intel product revenue. This does not prove NVIDIA will manufacture GPUs at Intel.

suggestedEdges.title: Completed Intel equity purchase
suggestedEdges.detail: Intel completed the sale of 86,956,522 shares to SoftBank for cash.
suggestedEdges.caveat: An equity financing inflow, not semiconductor revenue.

suggestedEdges.title: Custom AI fabric and Xeon chip framework
suggestedEdges.detail: Intel and AWS announced co-investment in custom designs, products and wafers, including an AI fabric chip on Intel 18A and custom Xeon 6 on Intel 3.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Framework value is not recognized revenue or verified cash paid. Allocation between co-investment and purchases is not disclosed; production completion is not established by this source.

suggestedEdges.title: NVIDIA compute and networking deployments
suggestedEdges.detail: A February 2026 partnership covers large-scale CPU deployment, millions of Blackwell/Rubin GPUs and Spectrum-X networking.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Hardware deployment roadmap is not a disclosed cash total; do not multiply device counts by invented prices.

suggestedEdges.title: AMD GPU purchases
suggestedEdges.status: initial 1 GW binding; up to 6 GW framework
suggestedEdges.detail: The AMD filing establishes an initial binding purchase commitment equivalent to 1 GW, directly or via authorized purchasers, within the broader 6 GW partnership.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Do not label all 6 GW as an unconditional paid order, or attach an unsourced dollar value.

suggestedEdges.title: Purchase-linked equity incentive
suggestedEdges.detail: AMD issued Meta a performance-based warrant. Vesting depends on GPU purchases and other contractual milestones.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Direction denotes delivery of a contingent financial right, not cash. As of June 27, 2026 no shares had vested or become exercisable; full exercise is not a completed investment.
suggestedEdges.directionEvidence: noncash right from issuer to customer

suggestedEdges.title: Expanded AI cloud agreement
suggestedEdges.detail: CoreWeave announced expanded cloud capacity for Meta through December 2032. The filing says the amount includes new capacity and exercise of an existing capacity option.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Not cash paid or annual revenue. Do not mechanically add earlier headline contract/option values, because option overlap is explicit.

suggestedEdges.title: Optical fiber and connectivity agreement
suggestedEdges.detail: Corning will supply optical fiber, cable and connectivity for Meta data-center expansion and expand North Carolina capacity.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Commitment ceiling, not completed cash payments or current-year revenue.

suggestedEdges.title: Hyperscaler DirectFlash storage design win
suggestedEdges.detail: Pure Storage named Meta as a DirectFlash design-win customer in its 2025 proxy; the subsequent FY2026 report says shipments for its hyperscaler design win began.
suggestedEdges.caveat: The later shipment report does not name the customer in that passage, so linking shipments to Meta is an inference across disclosures. Do not assign a cash amount, or assume all storage supports AI.

suggestedEdges.title: Arizona advanced silicon purchasing
suggestedEdges.detail: Apple disclosed a multibillion-dollar commitment to TSMC Fab 21 and said production of its chips had begun.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Broader Apple silicon procurement: no AI-only dollar allocation. Neither the entire US spending pledge nor all Apple chip purchases equal AI server capex.

suggestedEdges.title: Advanced packaging capacity support
suggestedEdges.detail: Apple is investing in the Amkor Arizona packaging facility and says it will be the first and largest customer. It will package TSMC-made Apple silicon.
suggestedEdges.caveat: Amkor factory cost is not Apple’s investment amount; no AI-only spending allocation. Source specifically also mentions iPhone chips.

suggestedEdges.title: Gemini models and cloud technology collaboration
suggestedEdges.detail: The joint statement says future Apple Foundation Models will use Google Gemini models and cloud technology; Apple Intelligence continues on-device and Private Cloud Compute.
suggestedEdges.caveat: This is a technology/dependency edge. The statement does not establish a payment amount, payment direction, or hosting all Apple Intelligence on Google Cloud.
suggestedEdges.directionEvidence: collaboration only; no documented money transfer

notes: This is a curated coverage recommendation, not an exhaustive worldwide ranking by market capitalization.
A public-company financial universe and a commercial relationship graph should have separate inclusion rules. Private labs or subsidiaries can be graph nodes without invented stock prices.
For missing metrics show not yet researched; never map absence to loss-making, no debt, no valuation or hidden-champion status.
Aliases improve discovery; brand, model, subsidiary, ADR and parent identities must not become duplicated public companies.
Public listings and dated documents were checked through the requested October 3, 2026 snapshot. Undated IR pages are identified with null dates; access occurred during this audit.
Tesla, SpaceX/xAI and additional frontier labs are handled by the parallel circulation_core researcher, not omitted from the overall team audit.
Existing roster presence does not guarantee visibility in every graph, sorted page or filtered view.
Relationship direction can represent equity, contingent rights, purchasing or technical dependency; not every edge is money paid.
